summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K with its second quarter 2026 results and a quarterly dividend announcement. The filing reports core EPS of $1.09 (up 16% year-over-year), net income of $2.1 billion, and a 16.3% core ROE. It is a routine earnings release, though the CEO mentions a long-term care reinsurance transaction announced the same day. The document contains no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event. As a routine foreign private issuer earnings report, no special-situation category applies. The reinsurance transaction referenced is not detailed; if material, it may be covered in a separate disclosure.
